overview_description.description:
Strapi is an open-source software helping developers to easily build, deploy, and manage APIs. Its open-source headless CMS provides backend functionality for applications and gives developers the freedom to use the tools of their choice for front-end frameworks. It’s called headless because the frontend is not part of the CMS, but there’s an API for content to show up on different devices.

The company was founded in 2016 and headquartered in Paris, Ile-de-France.
